controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 30,100 K and log g 4.13 (u1 0.075, u2 0.288): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Radius from Secondary radius 5.6 +/- 0.4 solar radii, Vilardell et al. (2010), A&A 509, A70, Table 2; mass from Secondary mass 15.4 +/- 1.2 solar masses, Vilardell et al. (2010), A&A 509, A70, Table 2; orbit from M31V J00443610+4129194: P 2.048644 d, time of primary minimum HJD 2452908.694, i 69.9 degrees and a 22.6 +/- 0.5 solar radii (Vilardell et al. (2010), A&A 509, A70, Table 2); the fit follows the procedure of Ribas et al. (2005), which adopts a circular orbit, in a semi-detached configuration (Sect. 4). a/R = 22.6/9.2 = 2.4565 primary radii. HJD is taken as BJD_TDB (under a minute apart); at the primary minimum the primary is eclipsed, so the secondary is in front.
